execution.intended_variable: background behind the five frozen Character cones only

direct_renderer_attempts.diagnosis: Renderer reauthored shell, Character names, cone layout, rail, action hierarchy and performance panel instead of editing the background.
Renderer again reauthored the interface and introduced literal ruin/city architecture, violating context-neutrality and the frozen-carrier contract.
A requested standalone background plate was ignored; the renderer produced another whole-interface redesign with literal architecture and story semantics.

execution.accepted_method: After three renderer scope-drift failures, Design Sol switched execution method without changing the brief: construct a restrained context-agnostic causal-field background deterministically/procedurally, composite it onto the exact frozen master, and reconstruct only the translucent cone-light contribution inside the original cone envelopes so story scenery does not survive through the beams.
execution.process_finding: For this pixel-preserving incumbent-refinement gate, direct whole-image generative editing was not reliable enough to preserve frozen UI/carrier structure. Deterministic compositing provided the needed variable isolation. This is a tool/method finding, not a global prohibition on image generation.

deterministic_preservation.cone_envelopes: Reconstruction is bounded to the original five cone polygons; no cone/card/portrait geometry was introduced.
deterministic_preservation.reduced_color_check: A grayscale audit preserves all five cone/floor/name units and leaves the background subordinate. criteria.name: preservation of every frozen cone/Character relation
criteria.evidence: Five positions, one-cone-per-Character relation, names, state labels, floor pools and creator actions are preserved; central floor/name/pip region is pixel-identical.

criteria.name: five-Character readability
criteria.evidence: All five Characters remain simultaneously legible with explicit names and state annotations.

criteria.name: cone/floor dominance
criteria.evidence: Background luminance/detail remains below the five light volumes and floor pools; grayscale audit preserves dominance.

criteria.name: context neutrality
criteria.evidence: Island/coast/ocean/storm/raft scenery and the story-background quote are removed from the background. Production/Scene/rail copy remains untouched because it is outside this visual-variable gate.

criteria.name: Kymaean identity
criteria.evidence: The background uses a restrained causal-field grammar: deep near-black atmosphere, volumetric pressure folds, accumulated-history strata and bounded continuity/current traces rather than generic scenery.

criteria.name: theatrical spatial depth
criteria.evidence: Soft recession, asymmetrical pressure pockets and layered atmospheric current structures provide depth without literal theater architecture.

criteria.name: human-causal rather than AI-tech character
criteria.evidence: No circuitry, neural-network diagrams, HUD/data grids, provider/model symbolism or machine iconography are introduced.

criteria.name: bounded/non-literal fiber influence
criteria.evidence: Interlaced influence appears only as sparse atmospheric continuity traces and never replaces or costumes the cones.

criteria.name: text/control competition
criteria.evidence: Top shell, right rail and performance/action surfaces are unchanged and the new background is quieter than the predecessor scenery.

criteria.name: accessibility/redundancy regression
criteria.evidence: Names, state labels, floor hinge and existing redundant cues are unchanged; background carries no required semantic state.

criteria.name: accidental ODR resolution
criteria.evidence: No new controls, pips, arc semantics, rail provenance, observation claims, Intervene behavior, Take acceptance, Turn/Beat ontology or scene-limit rule are introduced.

criteria.name: material improvement over frozen incumbent
criteria.evidence: The only explicitly failed long-term baseline element—the story-specific scenery—is replaced by a reusable default field while the frozen carrier and information architecture remain intact.
